responsibility: This machine-description fragment implements the C6X backend’s atomic synchronization operations and compare-and-swap expansion patterns. Instead of relying on problematic hardware atomics, it describes load/modify/store instruction sequences placed in overlapping branch shadows to guarantee atomicity on supported single-core systems, providing the RTL expanders and final insn forms for sync fetch-op, nand, old/new value, and CAS builtins with the backend’s dedicated atomic type annotations.
